summary: Permissive fapolicyd only logs violations: set `permissive = 1` in `/etc/fapolicyd/fapolicyd.conf` and run `systemctl restart fapolicyd.service`; discuss a waiver with your auditor if policy forbids it.
questions: How do I set fapolicyd permissive on a managed node?
Does permissive fapolicyd still log violations?
